correctness.rationale: The stopping time is the first full spanning round, and exact subspace-lattice Möbius inversion gives E tau = 1 + sum over fifteen hyperplanes q_H/(125-q_H) - r/62 for q_H=product of three hyperplane intersection sizes and r rainbow F2-projective lines. Every balanced unlabeled partition has a canonical block containing vector 1 then the least remaining vector, exactly C(14,4)C(9,4)=126126 layouts; scoring is rational with integer common denominator. Independently rebuilt all fifteen hyperplanes and 35 lines, exhaustively enumerated 126126 partitions, found thirteen distinct scores and exact optimum 7491/3596 attained 336 times, second best 99660239/47542716; independently observed every minimizing block is a 5-cap. The inspected checker enumerates all 1008 5-caps and all 20160 GL(4,2) matrices to establish the 336-element orbit and no others, and the second source checker uses 67-subspace Markov recursion on the witness. This is an exhaustive proof for that 15-column instance, not extrapolation.
